name: comp-400
title: Avatar Group 20px
blurb: Four overlapping avatars in a compact group.
description: Renders a group of four circular avatars at 20px size with negative margins to create an overlap effect. Each avatar has a thin ring border using theme background color.
use_when: A space-efficient way to show a small team or group of contributors in tight layouts like headers or compact cards.
avoid_when: More than four avatars or when you need individual avatar state — this is a static group layout.
a11y: Each image has alt text. No interactive elements or motion; passive layout.
